Title: [LSJ] Seeds of Corruption and Shadow Body

Messages.Author: Ethan Burrow
Messages.Body:
Vamp A has a Seed of Corruption placed on it. One action has already
been taken to remove it.

Vamp A attempts second action to remove Seeds of Corruption with 2 blood
on her, and is intercepted. Vamp A plays a Shadow Body to continue the
action as though unblocked. Vamp A now has 1 blood, does the action to
remove the Seeds of Corruption succeed?

--
Ethan Burrow - Prince of Austin
et...@ddg.com
http://whitestar.ddg.com/vtes/

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
et...@ddg.com (Ethan Burrow) wrote:
> Vamp A has a Seed of Corruption placed on it. One action has already
> been taken to remove it.
>
> Vamp A attempts second action to remove Seeds of Corruption with 2 blood
> on her, and is intercepted. Vamp A plays a Shadow Body to continue the
> action as though unblocked. Vamp A now has 1 blood, does the action to
> remove the Seeds of Corruption succeed?

Note: the "burn X additional blood for each action he performs" requires
him to burn blood when he first attempts the action (i.e., when the
action is announced). [LSJ 13-OCT-1997]

So, your example only works if the vampire in question is not a Follower
of Set and Seeds of Corruption was put into play at inferior.
So he burns one blood when he attempts the action. Then he gets blocked
and pays one blood to play Shadow Body.

--
